description: Fix-oracle exploration fixture (C2) for clean-question-presentation. Reconciled in task 4.6 (analogous to the shipped-fixture reconciliation in task 4.3): it now models the FIXED rendered comprehension-check turn — one clean, single, non-compound question composed the first time ('Does the overview make sense before we choose a track?') and shown exactly once, with the prose 'or ... clarify?' compound draft and the 'Let me ask that more cleanly as a single question.' regeneration line removed. Previously this fixture modeled the CURRENT (buggy) turn where the compound draft and its regenerated clean question BOTH reached the bootcamper, so the fixed-behavior assertions (exactly_one_pointer, no_compound_question) FAILED, confirming C2. With the turn reconciled to the single clean question those same assertions now PASS, validating that C2 is fixed. This fixture lives outside senzing-bootcamp/tests/eval on purpose so the default harness run and the shipped-fixture count stay unaffected.
